images.alt: A wide bar feeds into a three-way chute that splits it into three trays below. The left tray is heaped nearly full, the middle a quarter full, the right holds one small cube with calipers resting against it.
images.prompt: A single wide horizontal bar enters a three-way sorting chute drawn in the middle of the frame. The chute divides the bar into three streams that fall into three open trays standing side by side beneath it: the left tray heaped nearly full, the middle tray about a quarter full, the right tray holding one small cube. A pair of calipers rests beside the right tray, measuring the cube. The bar, the chute and the trays sit in a horizontal band across the centre, with clear empty space above and below and well in from both sides.

images.alt: Two printed slips, each with five credential lines. The upper slip has a filled-in owner box at the start of every line and an arrow to a closed door. The lower slip's boxes are empty and its arrow leads to an open door.
images.prompt: Two paper slips lie one above the other in the centre of the frame, each printed with five identical short lines of credential text. On the upper slip every line starts with a small boxed field that has been filled in; on the lower slip that same box is empty on every line. A short arrow runs from each slip to a door at the right: the upper door shut, the lower door standing wide open. Keep both slips and both doors inside the central area with clear margin on every side.
